Package com.wgblackmon.aihealthcare.infrastructure.persistence

Class RegulatoryEventEntity

java.lang.Object
com.wgblackmon.aihealthcare.infrastructure.persistence.RegulatoryEventEntity
@Entity public class RegulatoryEventEntity extends Object
JPA entity representing a row in the regulatory_events table.

Maps to the immutable RegulatoryEvent domain record. Conversion is performed inside RegulatoryEventAdapter. The aiHealthcareKeywords list is stored as a pipe-delimited string.
